page.notes: Doubtful readings: "multam" (the word after "Hieron ... dixisset quiddam inhonestum" is blurred; read as multam [?]); "Hom.38" is a faint numeral; "mag s" appears to be a printed spacing error for "magis" [?]; "vxore" and "iocari" are read as printed. Line-end hyphens are kept as printed ("mini-"). The small mark below the last line at the right is not a catchword or a legible signature and is left out. The strip of letters along the right edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. The page opens mid-paragraph, so the first paragraph is marked cont="true". The text is set in roman with no italics or black letter visible.
